turns.sentence: Hi, what do you do for work?
I'm a graphic designer. And you?
Nice, how long have you worked there?
I'm thinking about moving into project management — do you have any advice?
It's a great move if you enjoy coordinating people — I'd start by taking on smaller projects at work first.
That's a good starting point. Should I also look into certifications?
They can help, but real project experience will matter more when you're job hunting.
That's really helpful, thank you for the guidance.
It's been a while, but I remembered you'd mentioned wanting to move into product strategy eventually.
I did, and I'm flattered you remembered — has something come up?
My team is actually opening a role that sounds tailor-made for your background.
I'd love to hear more — would you be open to sending over the details?
Of course, I'll forward the posting and put in a good word on your behalf.
